name: Pipeliners - City Page Optimization Report 2026-09-01
body:
> Report · Pipeliners · 2026-09-01

# Summary
Work report on the 37 Pipeliners city pages and a sitewide copy cleanup. The trigger: in the 28 days to Aug 24 the city pages drew 6,940 impressions and 1 click, so they were visible but not persuading anyone to click. The work was data-led (per-page GSC keywords pulled first) and every edit was backed up and verified live.

# Key findings
- Tempe, Buckeye and Florence titles and metas did not match what people searched; none of the descriptions asked the reader to call.
- 23 of 37 city pages had link text reading only "here!" (46 links).
- Hydro jetting was missing from 8 city pages and repiping from 10. Six pages were thin (976 to 1,456 words vs 2,118 on Phoenix).
- Cross-page duplication was measured with 8-word shingles: average overlap 26.1%, worst pair 18.7%, far below where duplicate-content problems start. The template residue sweep was therefore deliberately not done.
- Gas line work is NOT a Pipeliners service. About 281 monthly gas impressions on Buckeye are false relevance; a hard block was added to the Buckeye edit script.
- The 480-447-5345 number on the free inspection page is not a defect (numbers are pulled dynamically from GoHighLevel).

# Results
- New titles: Tempe "Tempe, AZ Sewer Line Repair & Replacement | Pipeliners" (biggest keyword "sewer line repair in tempe az", 556 impressions at position 19). Buckeye "Pipe Break & Water Line Repair in Buckeye, AZ | Pipeliners". Florence title kept (it already matched "florence pipe break repair" at position 7); an earlier change was withdrawn to avoid a regression.
- Metas rewritten with a call to action and 480-535-6503.
- 37-page title and meta audit: 37 of 37 clean.
- 46 "here!" links replaced on 23 pages. Six pages expanded (for example Buckeye 1,901 to 2,312 words, Gilbert 1,456 to 1,880).
- Hydro jetting now on all 37 pages, repiping on all 37. 176 em dashes removed across 20 pages and posts.
- Similarity fell after the work (26.1% to 24.3%).
- Homepage videos already re-encoded (66.9 MB to 19 MB).

# Decisions and status
- Pending on Kim: keep OTTO's crawler off (protects titles but new posts get no meta); differentiate the two competing lining-vs-replace posts (no merge allowed at the time); confirm the trashed /pipeline-environmental-compliance-arizona/ 404.
- Ready to run: 19 older posts with no featured image; /contact/ title says Phoenix (office is Mesa); /privacy-policy/ meta date.
- Excluded on purpose: /trenchless-drain-pipe-repair/ (the main Google Ads final URL), Kitec and ePIPE compatibility, the "expansive soil" claim.
- Baseline locked at the 28 days ending Aug 24; first measurement Sep 24.
